section_summary.extract_value: This section details the incremental validity of mental toughness using hierarchical multiple regression analyses. It examines how trait-based and domain mental toughness predict various criteria, including post-practice self-efficacy, performance, task enjoyment, task knowledge, and adaptive performance, after controlling for variables such as GMA, CSE, videogame experience, goal orientation, baseline performance, and pre-practice self-efficacy. The results, presented in Table 2, indicate that domain mental toughness, particularly its self-belief subscale, significantly predicts post-practice self-efficacy and performance, while trait-based mental toughness does not.
